line_selection_method: Full-resolution edge-probability tensor line extraction + Gemini candidate-ID selection of receding/depth-parallel finite scene lines + per-frame Lu-style spherical VP voting/inlier clustering. Frontal left-to-right image-plane-parallel lines are explicitly rejected because they vanish at infinity rather than at the finite VP being tested.

The right wall features window frames with horizontal mullions that recede into depth towards a vanishing point on the left side of the image. The ceiling beams appear to be transverse and are excluded.
